notes: The paper is mainly a TDS study, but it also reports H2 adsorption isotherms at 77 K up to about 45 to 50 bar (insets of Figs. 4 and 5, wt% vs. bar) with maxima of 2.7 wt% (activated carbon) and 2.4 wt% (SWCNTs), so TDS is not the only uptake measurement. The paper does not name the isotherm technique (gravimetric or volumetric) and gives no experimental details for it; an uptake-vs-pressure isotherm from the gas phase is necessarily one of the two, so I1 is judged met. The paper does not say whether these isotherms were published earlier, so duplicate_data does not apply on the paper's own statement. Surface area: BET 1065 m2/g (activated carbon, N2 at 77 K) and 854 m2/g for the purified HiPco SWCNTs (method not stated). Not a review; not retracted (record flag false, no retraction notice in the PDF); no supplementary files supplied.
